name: Lily Borgstrom
source:
Lily Borgstrom is the baby sister of [url=/c176653]Natasha[/url] and runs Dahlia's bar in the absence of her sister. The youngest of four, she didn't manage to wiggle her way out of taking over her sister's duties. Much like her sister, Lily hopes to see the world before she goes back to school to finish her teacher's degree. She dreams of taking a year to sail the globe. Lily is confident, sweet, and adventurous.

[Edited from in-game description]
